assets.label: Upper Center Sailboat
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Standalone transparent sailboat asset from the upper-center boat in the grouped boats overlay.
Primary request: Create a standalone transparent-background cutout of a single stylized white sailboat matching the reference crop. Preserve the isometric miniature render style, white triangular sail, slim mast, white hull, warm beige interior shadowing, soft grey edge shading, and the same upper-center sailboat orientation. Output only this one sailboat, with no docks, marina pieces, water, shoreline, or other boats.
Input images: the crop is a reference image only. Generate a brand-new standalone asset; do not copy crop pixels.
Composition/framing: match the reference crop's subject, angle, aspect ratio, and visual weight.
Constraints: remove neighboring-page contamination, occluding unrelated assets, webpage framing, and collage leftovers.
Transparency/background: Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for later alpha removal; do not use #00ff00 in the subject.
Avoid: crop output, screenshot, full page mockup, browser frame, watermark, placeholder, unrelated typography.
assets.negative_prompt: No docks, no marina pieces, no second boat, no blue water, no shoreline, no rectangular crop background, no text, no watermark.
